WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30 22:00' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-01 22:00'),
s AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) lines, min(sale_date) sd, max(sale_date) sd2, sum(gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, count(s.receipt_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN s.lines<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) guests, sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='guest' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) guest_state
FROM o LEFT JOIN s ON s.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30 22:00' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-01 22:00'),
s AS (SELECT receipt_id, channel_id, count(*) lines, sum(gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT o.status, s.channel_id, count(*) n, count(s.receipt_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN s.lines<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lc_mis, sum(CASE WHEN abs(s.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tot_mis
FROM o LEFT JOIN s ON s.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
